stories.title: Le zurichois On entre avec fracas sur le terrain du football en signant avec Kylian Mbappé et Thierry Henry

en.title: Zurich-based On makes a splash in football by signing Kylian Mbappé and Thierry Henry
en.summary: Swiss equipment manufacturer On announced a major entry into football by signing World Cup champion Kylian Mbappé as an ambassador and shareholder, marking a significant victory against competitor Nike.

stories.title: KURZMELDUNGEN - Wirtschaft: Volkswagen erwartet für 2026 tiefen Gewinn +++ Bank of Japan erhöht Leitzins auf höchsten Stand seit 31 Jahren

en.title: BRIEF REPORTS - Economy: Volkswagen expects deep profit for 2026 +++ Bank of Japan raises key interest rate to highest level in 31 years
en.summary: Volkswagen forecasts significantly reduced profits in 2026. The Bank of Japan has increased its benchmark interest rate to its highest level in three decades.

stories.title: Tourismus im Aargau – Sissi-Fans sollen die Wiege der Habsburger entdecken

en.title: Tourism in Aargau – Sissi fans should discover the cradle of the Habsburgs
en.summary: The canton of Aargau aims to better promote the historic origins of the Habsburg dynasty as a tourism attraction, questioning whether opportunities have been missed previously.

stories.title: Wie tropische Mücken in Deutschland Flughafenmalaria verbreiten

en.title: How tropical mosquitoes in Germany spread airport malaria
en.summary: Tropical mosquitoes transported by aircraft to Frankfurt airport infected six airport employees with malaria, with two additional residents becoming ill this week and three fatalities reported.

stories.title: Messerattacke von Oerlikon: «Besonders verwerflich war die Motivation» – chinesischer Student wegen mehrfachen versuchten Mordes schuldig gesprochen

en.title: Oerlikon knife attack: "The motivation was particularly reprehensible" – Chinese student convicted of multiple attempted murder
en.summary: A man who attacked kindergarten children with a knife in 2024 was sentenced to 15 years in prison on Friday. Correspondence provides insights into the lives of the victims.

stories.title: Keine Entspannung – Trockenheit verschärft sich weiter

en.title: No relief – drought intensifies further
en.summary: No rain is expected in the near term and many areas remain significantly dry. Drought conditions are continuing to worsen.

stories.title: Entre Glencore et Radiant, des tensions croissantes sur fond de documents falsifiés

en.title: Between Glencore and Radiant, mounting tensions over forged documents
en.summary: The Zug-based commodities giant accused a Singapore-based iron ore trader of falsifying banking documents on Tuesday. The trader responded Wednesday by demanding 2 billion dollars in damages.

stories.title: Plaidoyer pour une neutralité véritablement en faveur de la paix plutôt qu’inscrite dans la Constitution

en.title: Plea for a neutrality truly serving peace rather than enshrined in the Constitution
en.summary: An emeritus professor and historian of international relations warns against an initiative to constitutionally enshrine neutrality, arguing instead for Switzerland to serve peace as a means of defending its independence.

stories.title: «Ces deux dernières semaines ont été très, très difficiles pour Donald Trump»: aux Etats-Unis, le président accumule les déconvenues

en.title: "These past two weeks have been very, very difficult for Donald Trump": in the United States, the president accumulates setbacks
en.summary: Donald Trump has recently faced multiple setbacks from the Supreme Court and the Federal Reserve, while Republican loyalty is eroding and the president expresses fatigue with politics.

stories.title: Dalibor Stevanović, entraîneur à succès du Stade Lausanne-Ouchy: «C’est un honneur que le FC Bâle s’intéresse à moi»

en.title: Dalibor Stevanović, successful coach of Stade Lausanne-Ouchy: "It is an honor that FC Basel is interested in me"
en.summary: The 41-year-old Slovenian coach confirms contact with FC Basel, which is seeking a successor to Stephan Lichtsteiner, as Stade Lausanne-Ouchy leads the Challenge League.

stories.title: Violaine Blétry-de Montmollin quittera le Conseil communal de Neuchâtel à la fin juin 2027

en.title: Violaine Blétry-de Montmollin will leave the Neuchâtel Municipal Council at the end of June 2027
en.summary: Liberal-radical councillor Violaine Blétry-de Montmollin will depart the Neuchâtel Municipal Council in June 2027 after ten years of service and will not pursue higher political office.

stories.title: A Neuchâtel, Violaine Blétry-de Montmollin quitte la politique et relance le suspense sur la succession de Laurent Favre au Conseil d’Etat

en.title: In Neuchâtel, Violaine Blétry-de Montmollin leaves politics and reopens the suspense over Laurent Favre's succession to the State Council
en.summary: Councillor Violaine Blétry-de Montmollin is stepping down from Neuchâtel's executive on June 30 and ending her political career, leaving the February state council election wide open.

stories.title: KURZMELDUNGEN - Wirtschaft: Volkswagen erwartet für 2026 tiefen Gewinn +++ Bank of Japan erhöht Leitzins auf höchsten Stand seit 31 Jahren

en.title: BRIEF REPORTS - Economy: Volkswagen expects deep profit for 2026 +++ Bank of Japan raises key interest rate to highest level in 31 years
en.summary: Volkswagen forecasts significantly reduced profits in 2026. The Bank of Japan has increased its benchmark interest rate to its highest level in three decades.

stories.title: Glencore suspendiert Mitarbeiter, der die Deals mit dem kontroversen Händler Radiant betreute

en.title: Glencore suspends employee who handled deals with controversial trader Radiant
en.summary: Glencore has suspended an employee responsible for transactions with Radiant, a controversial trader. Multiple Swiss financial and trading firms are affected by the alleged fraud involving the multi-billion-dollar iron ore trade.

stories.title: Putin stellt Nestlés Russland-Geschäft unter Zwangsverwaltung – Bundesbern zeigt sich besorgt

en.title: Putin places Nestlé's Russia business under state administration – Federal Bern expresses concern
en.summary: The Kremlin has placed Nestlé's Russian operations under state control, citing Switzerland's classification as an unfriendly country. Nestlé faces potential expropriation as part of broader Kremlin actions against Western companies remaining in Russia.

stories.title: Nach der Entwendung von Kundendaten fordern Erpresser von Revolut 3 Millionen Dollar

en.title: After theft of customer data, extortionists demand 3 million dollars from Revolut
en.summary: Fraudsters obtained personal information from the neobank Revolut by impersonating Italian law enforcement authorities. Swiss customers are among those affected by the data breach and extortion attempt.

stories.title: Warren Buffett tritt auch als Verwaltungsratspräsident von Berkshire Hathaway zurück

en.title: Warren Buffett Steps Down as Chairman of Berkshire Hathaway
en.summary: Warren Buffett, 96, has relinquished his role as chairman of Berkshire Hathaway after stepping down as CEO earlier this year. His son Howard Buffett will assume the chairman position.
